## Kimi K3.1 Pro E2EE API

Kimi K3.1 Pro E2EE is a large language model by Moonshot AI, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-kimi-k3-1-pro-p`. This model supports end-to-end encryption (E2EE) and runs in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Your prompt is encrypted on your client and decrypted on the GPU within the TEE. The response is then encrypted and sent back to your client for decryption. Venice's system prompt and web search are disabled to preserve end-to-end encryption. Attestation evidence is available for independent verification. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [Kimi K3.1 Pro](/models/kimi-k3-1-pro).

Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot AI's flagship multimodal reasoning model and the post-trained successor to Kimi K3, with a 1M-token context window. It is built for long-horizon coding, agentic workflows, financial research, and 3D modeling through CAD code.

### How to use the Kimi K3.1 Pro E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-kimi-k3-1-pro-p"` and your API key.

This sample sends the prompt as plaintext, so the request runs TEE-only. For end-to-end encryption, send encrypted messages with the E2EE headers, as the [TEE and E2EE guide](/guides/features/tee-e2ee-models#e2ee-models) shows.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-kimi-k3-1-pro-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "max"
  }'
```
